lines: Refused to stop a session no company record could identify. Escalated with the evidence.

tech.title: Incident injected: Unknown workload holds the lock

events.caption: checkout starts failing (4 timed out so far).

tech.title: Checkout degraded: 4 timeouts since injection, success 0%
12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 92193 (batch_worker/adhoc_reporting, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s); last statement: SELECT 1
Checkout over last 15s: 33/60 succeeded (55%), 27 timeouts.
Checkout success 77% over 10s (7/31 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,155/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

detail.query: SELECT s.service, s.slo_success_rate, s.slo_p95_ms, s.verification_window_s, s.revenue_per_minute_cents, s.max_degradation_s, s.tier, t.total, t.failed FROM continuity.service_slo s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM shop.checkout_events WHERE created_at > current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 SECONDS) t WHERE s.service = 'checkout'

No relevant memories (searched 20)

events.caption: proposes to stop the adhoc_reporting job.

tech.title: R1 proposes terminate:adhoc_reporting

detail.rationale: The root blocker is pid 92193 (batch_worker/adhoc_reporting) idle in transaction for 4.0s, blocking 1 session and contributing to 12 sessions waiting on locks [DB-1]. Checkout success is 55% over 15s [TEL-1] and 77% over 10s vs 95% SLO, with $4,155/min revenue at risk and only 60s tolerance for degradation [BIZ-1]. Terminating this idle-in-transaction session releases its locks immediately with minimal blast radius, as it's a batch worker running adhoc reporting (likely replayable).

detail.objection: Missing change-calendar evidence for the blocking workload (biz.change_calendar). Per I2, termination requires both workload-registry and change-calendar evidence. The registry shows adhoc_reporting is unknown (BIZ-2), so the cost of interruption cannot be priced (I4). Without change-calendar evidence we cannot verify whether an active change window with policy consult_owner applies (I3).
detail.business_rationale: Checkout is at 28% success vs 95% SLO with $13,340/min revenue at risk and only 60s tolerance (BIZ-3). The blocker is an unknown workload (BIZ-2) with unknown interrupt cost (BIZ-4). No protected settlements in flight (DB-2). Termination may be justified but requires change-calendar evidence to satisfy I2 and I3.

detail.query: SELECT c.change_id, c.scope, c.policy, c.reason, c.window_start, c.window_end, w.application_name, w.owner_team FROM RP_CHANGE_MGMT.change_calendar c JOIN continuity.workload_registry w ON c.scope_type = 'job' AND c.scope = w.job_name WHERE w.application_name IN ('adhoc_reporting') AND current_timestamp() BETWEEN to_timestamp(c.window_start, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX") AND to_timestamp(c.window_end, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX")
